name: peat_kalteng
source: Global Forest Watch, Indonesia peat lands (original: Kementan/BBSDLP peat map), https://gis-gfw.wri.org/arcgis/rest/services/country_data/asia/MapServer/10
license: UNVERIFIED (GFW open data portal; CC BY 4.0 assumed; original: Kementan/BBSDLP peat map)
note: Peat polygons clipped to the box around Central Kalimantan (not the province outline), simplified with a tolerance of 0.0005 degree, coordinates to 4 decimals, for drawing only. The source layer was itself downloaded with a generalisation of 0.002 degree. The peat test of peat_persistence_kalteng.json uses the source polygons, so a site near an edge can sit just outside the drawn outline.
